I had a terrible experience with the female counter staff. Her service was awful, and her attitude was rude. My friend's braces came loose, but she claimed two had come loose. If I hadn't told my friend, we would have had to pay 1,000 baht. When I called to confirm, she initially argued that two had come loose, but it turned out only one had. I asked if I would have had to pay 1,000 baht if I hadn't called, to which she replied, "You haven't transferred the money yet, so there's no damage." The first thing you should do is offer a sincere apology, not speak like that to a patient. No one deserves to be treated like this. I hope this doesn't happen again on my next visit. I was very disappointed today. However, the doctor was good; she had a gentle touch and explained things clearly.
